svg.title: Homer's Odyssey — the campaign mark
svg.desc: A black ship under a square sail - the one thing every chapter of the poem has in it. Stroked on the 24-grid like the element marks, and built to survive at the size of a card code: a hull, a mast and a sail, three strokes, nothing finer. Printed beside the card code of every card that belongs to the campaign. Generated by tools/build-icons.mjs from data/campaigns.json and data/components.json - do not edit. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
